tokens.name: cp-bg
tokens.usage: App background (body). Deepest of the three layers.

tokens.name: cp-surface
tokens.usage: Inset layer: poster placeholders, input wells, code/path strips.

tokens.name: cp-card
tokens.usage: Card and modal surface. Sits on cp-bg; cards are flat, no shadow.

tokens.name: cp-border
tokens.usage: Dividers, table header rule, ghost-button outline, skeleton blocks. Decorative only: 1.17:1 on cp-bg in dark, so never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: cp-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on cp-bg, cp-surface and cp-card (dark 13.7:1 on card, light 17.4:1 on card).

tokens.name: cp-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, years, table headers, inactive nav on cp-bg and cp-card (dark 6.6:1, light 5.3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: cp-accent
tokens.usage: Brand cyan. Fills (primary button, toggle on, info toast, skip link), active-nav tint at 10%. As text in dark only; use cp-accent-text for text.

tokens.name: cp-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: cp-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on cp-accent and cp-accent-hover fills (10.4:1). Always black: cp-bg turns near-white in light and would fail.

tokens.name: cp-accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text and links on cp-bg/cp-card, incl. active nav (dark 9.0:1, light 4.9:1). Light value is base.html's .text-cp-accent override.

tokens.name: cp-focus-ring
tokens.usage: The :focus-visible outline, 2px solid, offset 2px. 9.0:1 on dark card, 5.4:1 on light card.

tokens.name: cp-success
tokens.usage: Done/downloaded state fills and tints (bg at 10-20%).

tokens.name: cp-warning
tokens.usage: Snatched/review state, restart banner tint. Solid fill with black text for badges over poster art (9.4:1).

tokens.name: cp-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: outline at 30%, hover tint at 10%.

tokens.name: cp-success-text
tokens.usage: Success as text on cp-card and tints (dark 10.1:1, light 5.5:1). Over poster artwork use cp-success with class on-dark instead.

tokens.name: cp-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning as text on cp-card and tints (dark 8.1:1, light 5.0:1).

tokens.name: cp-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger as text on cp-bg and cp-card (dark 4.9:1 on card, light 6.5:1).

tokens.name: cp-danger-strong
tokens.usage: Dark-theme danger text for Mark failed / Replace confirm, which sit on a 10% danger tint over cp-card (5.47:1 on #2c1b1d).

tokens.name: cp-switch-off
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off (aria-checked=false), both themes: 3.7:1 on dark card, 4.8:1 on light card; white knob 4.8:1 on it.

tokens.name: cp-switch-on
tokens.usage: Toggle track when on: cp-accent in dark (9.0:1 on card), #0e7490 in light (5.4:1 on card).

tokens.name: cp-switch-knob-on
tokens.usage: Toggle knob when on: near-black on the dark cyan track (9.7:1), white on the light track (5.4:1). Off knob is always white.

tokens.name: cp-toast-success
tokens.usage: Success toast fill (Tailwind green-700), both themes. White text 5.0:1.

tokens.name: cp-toast-error
tokens.usage: Error toast fill (Tailwind red-700), both themes. White text 6.5:1.

tokens.name: cp-toast-fg
tokens.usage: Toast text on cp-toast-success and cp-toast-error. Theme-independent by design.

tokens.name: cp-chrome
tokens.usage: Floating chrome (sidebar, mobile top bar, bottom nav) with backdrop-blur-xl.

tokens.name: cp-scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop and poster-card overlay buttons.

tokens.name: cp-hairline
tokens.usage: Settings row dividers, sidebar edges, table data rows (white/[0.04]).

tokens.name: cp-hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Hairline borders (white/[0.06]); native text-input boundaries are repainted with cp-input-border for WCAG 1.4.11.

tokens.name: cp-input-border
tokens.usage: Native input, select, and textarea boundaries; 3.74:1 on the dark card and 4.83:1 on the light card.

tokens.name: cp-input-focus-border
tokens.usage: Focused native input, select, and textarea boundaries; remains above 3:1 while preserving the accent state.

tokens.name: cp-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Input fill and the hover fill for ghost buttons and inactive nav items.

tokens.name: cp-poster-hover
tokens.usage: Poster-card border on hover, paired with shadow poster-glow.

tokens.name: cp-scrollbar-track
tokens.usage: Scrollbar track (6px wide).

tokens.name: cp-scrollbar-thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb, radius 3px.

tokens.name: cp-scrollbar-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb on hover.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page and section titles (text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body copy and primary buttons (text-sm).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav labels and settings field labels (text-[13px] font-medium).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Helper text, years, table headers (uppercase, wide tracking) (text-[10px]).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status and quality pills (text-[9px] font-medium, lowercase).

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Release table size/seeders and directory paths (font-mono font-light in a text-xs table).

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Nav item stack gap; badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between badges.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding; icon-to-label gap in small buttons; helper-text top margin.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control vertical padding (py-2); small gaps (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Poster card body padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding (px-3); nav icon gap (gap-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Primary button horizontal padding; modal and table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding and error panel padding.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar expanded (w-56).

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar collapsed (w-16), 300ms transition.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar (h-12).

tokens.name: sidebar-header
tokens.usage: Sidebar logo row height (h-14).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for settings inputs (min-h-[44px]).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav items and badges (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, poster cards, compact buttons (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, toasts, restart banner, skip link (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and panels (rounded-xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggle track and knob (rounded-full).

shadow.note: Depth comes from the bg/surface/card layers and hairlines, not shadows. The poster hover glow is the only shadow.

tokens.name: poster-glow
tokens.usage: Poster card hover, with cp-poster-hover border, 0.2s transition.
